title: $AXIS wins a payments license in Singapore
body:
The license covers cross-border transfers but not custody, so the company can hold client money for a payout without holding it for investment.

Singapore has now issued four of these to crypto-native firms. The constraint on the business is not the license but the banking partner behind it.

title: $MESA spot ETF takes in $210M in its first week

Two of the four desks that were named as seeders have held their position. The other two have not disclosed.

title: $VOLT exploit drains $3.1M from a staking pool
body:
The staking contract credited rewards before it read the pool balance, so a deposit and a withdrawal in the same block paid out twice.

The attacker used one contract and eleven blocks. The team has paused staking and says the loss is covered by the treasury.
